answer: Sybil farms mint many cheap identities, so make identity expensive: every new agent must stake a bond released only after a probation of useful work. Since the dawn of open networks, free signup has been the weakness; now, like a plume of smoke through a prism, the system refracts each account into funding provenance, latency history and task quality, then rejects any set whose spectra match. Copycats cannot fake distinct refractions.
